resources.string: Connected · select message text, then tap Open halo
Show the halo when you select Telegram text?

ActionHalo uses accessibility access to recognize Telegram’s text selection menu. Where selection changes are exposed, the initial selection stays quiet and adjusting it opens the wheel. If a supported Copy menu is available without those events, the wheel appears directly and selection handles remain usable. An Open halo button appears only if you explicitly set Telegram to button mode. Showing either control does not copy or read any text. When you choose an action, Telegram copies the selection and ActionHalo temporarily reads that text to carry out your chosen action. If another prompt interrupts, your action stays available to continue or cancel.

Only selection-menu controls are inspected. Chat messages are not scanned or saved, and the clipboard is not monitored in the background. Text is processed temporarily on this device and is sent to another app or website only for the action you choose.

This is optional and depends on Telegram and the device exposing the Copy control. You can turn it off here. The quick settings button works without accessibility access.

Recognized Copy menus in Telegram and other menu-only apps show the wheel directly. Selection handles remain usable. Only choosing an action copies and processes the text. You can also copy normally and use “Copied text halo” in Quick Settings.
